items.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And thank God he’s still around and that he’ll play with somebody like me.

ctx.x: Well speaking of home movies, thank you for this video, which you got to play with Sweets. What was it like to work with him?

He’s a great guy, a really wonderful guy. And again, like I talked about Benny, he still, he’s getting up there in years but he still comes out to play, sounds great, he’s one of these people that when you hear a few notes you know it’s him. He’s an individual, he’s his own man, and he’s a legend. And thank God he’s still around and that he’ll play with somebody like me. I like him very much.

Just to wrap up, this weekend you’ll be playing with some pretty well-known musicians. Has there ever been any awkward moments at these? I know that the promoters, they kind of juggle people, they bring in all individuals, no bands really. And have you ever had a circumstance where the chemistry that they put together just hasn’t worked?
